category: research testbed - free bare metal and storage nodes

free_tier.stated: 534 nodes across KVM@TACC, CHI@UC, CHI@TACC, CHI@NRP; 62 nodes with >1TB total storage, dedicated 'storage' (20) and 'storage_nvme' (10) node classes, plus 297 nodes at 400GB-1TB

egress.terms: free within allocation; no published byte meter

interface_detail: OpenStack API (Nova/Cinder/Blazar), CLI, Jupyter; ssh to instances
tooling: python-chi, openstackclient, blazar reservations, Trovi artifacts, Daypass for artifact reproduction
chaining: bare-metal reservation -> local NVMe -> object store you run yourself
limits_note: PI status is the binding constraint and is 'limited to faculty and research staff at US-based academic institutions'. International PIs are supported only as 'a limited number ... with ongoing, active collaborations with scientists in the US'. Students explicitly excluded except NSF GRFP holders. Accounts deactivate after 120 days' inactivity. FPGA resources additionally refuse residents or citizens of Iran, Iraq, North Korea, Sudan, Syria.
reliability_note: Project expiry immediately revokes all access and the allocation; storage is not offered as a durable service.

evidence.proved: 'PI status is limited to faculty and research staff at US-based academic institutions'

eligibility list: academic institutions (research staff/faculty in supervisory positions), federal agencies, 'a limited number of international PIs with ongoing, active collaborations with scientists in the US', NSF Graduate Student Fellows, US museums/libraries/labs, K-12 educators; 'We do occasionally provide case-by-case exceptions ... in well-justified cases'
